title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
hook_text: Websites are locking out AI agents
script:
Websites are now blocking autonomous AI agents from scraping their data.
OpenAI, Meta, and Google are building agents to scour the web for you.
These tools promise to book dinner reservations or buy your shoes automatically.
Instinct is also racing to build these autonomous web-scouring bots.
Website owners are using robots.txt files to stop these automated scrapers.
This friction makes it harder for autonomous tools to function for users.
Would you trust a bot to handle your personal errands?

editor.one_line: Strong reporting, but the visual presentation is repetitive and lacks dynamic variety.
script_fixes: LINE 3: Replace 'buy your shoes' with a more specific example like 'purchase flight tickets' to sound more professional.
LINE 6: Replace 'This friction' with 'These blocks' for more direct, punchy language.
visual_notes: line 3: The 'Agent tasks' graphic is held for too long across multiple frames, becoming static.
line 4: The 'Instinct' logo/text is held for too long, lacking visual movement.
line 5: The 'robots.txt' visual is repeated across three frames without variation.
